I've been using this serum for a little over a month now and am starting to see results. After the first couple of weeks I was nervous nothing was happening, but the company said to keep using as results usually come through after 30 days of consistent use. So I continued to follow the directions by using it once a day at night before I would go to sleep. Now my lashes have gotten darker, longer, and fuller! I think I just needed to be patient with this stuff...I'm always looking for fast result

So far it's only week no change but I have no itching and redness in my eyes that's more impressed me because my eyes r very sensitive. Come back after couple week with new views.

reviews.t: The lash serum is easy to apply with the wand
reviews.x: The package arrived on time - no issues at all! The lash serum is easy to apply with the wand! It also doubles as a eyebrow growth serum! It does not make my skin feel sticky or look as though I have a second layer of skin!

This product is clear, not runny, easy to apply and non irritating. So far I really like it. I just started it, but I have used all lash enhancing products for as long as I can remember. I prefer the texture of this product to the runnier more expensive products. I will re post after a month to see how it goes. So far its a 5 star for me.

I have tried a lot of products and all of them worked but this is definitely the best.  Best product for best price.  It did not irritate my eyes but it does gunk  them up if the product gets in the eyes.  I am careful to only put it at the baseline of my lashes.

This is my second tube of Lavish Lash... I love it!!! The price point is great and the results are fantastic!!! Don’t expect over night results but w in a few weeks you will definitely notice a difference in the length and fullness of your lashes!!!

This product HAPPILY surprised me by it ACTUALLY WORKING! You have to use it daily but within two weeks all of a sudden I have eyebrow hair again! I didn’t use it on my eyelashes because they seem fine already so I thought t would be kind of a waste. It has no smell and the serum is thin enough to not dry up or become clumpy in the tube and dries pretty quickly. I have Hashimotos disease which has a side effect of eyebrow alopecia so this has been a life changer.

claims.text: Reviewers commonly report thicker, longer, or fuller lashes after consistent use, often noticing results within a few weeks to a couple of months.
Many reviewers say the serum is easy to apply and non-irritating, with a pleasant consistency and no noticeable scent.
Several reviewers praise the price point as more affordable than comparable alternatives while delivering similar results.
Some reviewers note that results take time and require patience, with little change in the first weeks.
A few reviewers mention skepticism before trying the product, and one reports it did not work at all.
